$comment: IA of the BinarBase homepage clone. Section order taken from src/App.jsx and CLONE_SPEC.md §2 (measured DOM order on the live site). Only the English homepage was cloned; the live site's other routes (/insights, case studies, legal pages, /cs/, /sk/) were not measured and are listed in README.md as out of scope rather than modelled as templates.

meta.source: https://binarbase.com/ (English homepage), cloned in this project

categories.SHELL: Page chrome that is not content: fixed background, navigation, footer, consent overlay.
categories.INTRO: Full-viewport scroll-captured opening experience shown before the hero.
categories.HERO: Page-opening headline block with the primary calls to action.
categories.PROOF: Customer evidence: client logos and case-study cards.

shell.aurora-background.description: Fixed, full-page decorative backdrop: three blurred aurora colour layers, a mesh gradient and a noise overlay that show through every transparent section.
shell.aurora-background.scope: Present on the 1 cloned route, behind all content.

shell.navbar.description: Fixed 71px glass navigation (logo, anchor links, language dropdown, log in / sign up). Turns dark (html.sbi-dark) while the 3D intro is under it; collapses to a hamburger with a 320px slide-in drawer at ≤1024px.

intro.second-brain-3d.description: 100svh dark (#070c1f) three.js scene of a 'second brain' with 7 story chapters; wheel/arrow/swipe input steps chapters before releasing normal page scroll, with skip and explore actions.
intro.second-brain-3d.scope: Homepage only, first block on the 1 cloned route.

hero.headline.description: Centred page-opening block: pulsing 'AI brain' badge, two-line headline (second line in brand gradient), subtitle, and a sign-up call to action, with skewed drifting gradient blobs behind it on the right.
hero.headline.scope: Homepage only, directly after the intro.

features.upgraded.description: Section 01 (#upgraded): numbered header, a 'same word, three different numbers' mismatch panel (one metric defined three ways across source systems, plus a callout), then a comparison table.

features.connectors-mcp.description: Section 02 (no anchor id): connectors and MCP, centred on an animated brain core with heartbeat, pulse rings and six floating integration icons, plus connector cards; clicking the core triggers a 1.2s excited state.

features.engine.description: Section 03 (#how-it-works) on the #f6f9fc band: a three-step Capture → Curate → Serve flow joined by arrows; the middle step is highlighted with a 'private AI' badge.
features.engine.scope: Homepage only; target of the 'How it works' nav link.

features.console.description: Section 04 (#console): two side-by-side panes (stacked at ≤968px) — managing context in the BinarBase console (with a mock definitions UI) versus working from your own AI tools over MCP.

features.product-showcase.description: Section 05 (#product) on the #f6f9fc band: horizontal carousel of 5 product cards with mock UIs, arrow buttons and dot pagination; no auto-advance.
features.product-showcase.scope: Homepage only; target of the 'Product' nav link.

features.deployment-modes.description: Section 06 (#deployment) on the #f6f9fc band: 3-way switch between cloud, private cloud and on-premise with an animated flow diagram and comparison table; auto-cycles every 4.5s while in view until the user picks a mode.

proof.customer-stories.description: Section 07 (#proof): a static row of 11 real client logos (no marquee) and 3 case-study cards linking to /insights pages.

solutions.teams-tree.description: Section 08 (#teams): hover-driven department tree (Finance selected by default) that highlights a branch and swaps a detail card, followed by 4 trust cards.
solutions.teams-tree.scope: Homepage only; target of the 'Solutions' nav link.

conversion.pricing-quote.description: Section 09 (#pricing): header and lede, a dashed 'get started yourself or with us' setup banner, then a single on-request quote card listing 15 included features; no tiered price table.
conversion.pricing-quote.scope: Homepage only; target of the 'Pricing' nav link.

conversion.final-cta.description: Closing call-to-action card over a radial glow, with a 'Start Free Trial' sign-up link and a 'Schedule Demo' button that has no action (as on the original), directly before the footer.

shell.footer.description: Site footer: brand column (logo, tagline, 3 social icons), a Product link column, and a Contact column (email, phone, address); bottom bar with copyright and 4 legal-page links.

shell.cookie-consent.description: Non-modal cookie consent dialog fixed to the bottom of the viewport; stores the choice in the bb_cookie_consent cookie. The clone loads no analytics either way.
shell.cookie-consent.scope: Overlay on the 1 cloned route until dismissed.
